cohort: Women who delivered between 2006 and 2016 at two university hospitals
finding: Laparoscopic sleeve gastrectomy was associated with reduced rates of gestational diabetes mellitus, excessive fetal growth, and cesarean delivery and an increased rate of SGA and low-birth-weight neonates.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery rates during labor were lower in the study group (10.1% vs 20.2%, P=.04).
